confidence_notes: Food, coffee and beer use a Hanoi-specific aggregated price snapshot from June 2026, close to the July pricing window. Cocktail and wine prices vary widely; their anchors are approximate bar prices around five times the domestic draft beer anchor. Accommodation estimates are holistic and are the least certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: No comparable city used; food and drink anchors are based on Hanoi-specific price data, with accommodation estimated from general knowledge of Hanoi.
